summary: The Electrochemical Society is a United States-based learned society that supports scientific inquiry in electrochemistry and solid-state science and technology. It has more than 8,000 individual members in over 70 countries and roughly 100 corporate and laboratory members.
one_line: The Electrochemical Society is a US-based professional association promoting electrochemistry and solid-state science, with over 8,000 individual members.
key_facts: The Electrochemical Society is a learned society (professional association) based in the United States.
The Electrochemical Society supports scientific inquiry in electrochemistry and solid-state science and technology.
The society has more than 8,000 individual members.
Individual members of the Electrochemical Society are scientists and engineers located in over 70 countries worldwide.
The Electrochemical Society has roughly 100 corporations and laboratories holding corporate membership.
